player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma spanning {num_rounds} rounds.

Game Structure:
- Before each decision you have {total_conversation_rounds} turns to communicate freely.
- After that, both players simultaneously choose to cooperate or defect.

Payoff Matrix (fixed each round):
- Both Cooperate ➜ each {cooperate_reward}
- Both Defect ➜ each {mutual_defect_reward}
- One Defects, one Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

How to Play:
- During conversation: type any text you wish.
- During decision phase: include '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). You may add extra text before/after the token.

phases.conversation_finished: ການສົນທະນາ ສໍາເລັດ ສໍາ ລັບຮອບ {round}. ກະລຸນາຕອບດ້ວຍ "[Cooperate]" ຫຼື "[Defect]" ພາຍໃນ \boxed{{}}.
phases.starting_round: --- ການເລີ່ມຕົ້ນຮອບ {round} ---
phases.round_summary: ຜົນການແຂ່ງຂັນຮອບ {round}: {outcome} ຜູ້ນ 0 ໄດ້ {r0} (ລວມ {score_0}), ຜູ້ນ 1 ໄດ້ {r1} (ລວມ {score_1}).

outcome.winner: ຜູ້ນ {winner} ຊະນະ {win_score} - {lose_score}.
outcome.draw: ແຕ່ງ! ນັກເຕະທັງສອງໄດ້ຄະແນນ {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: ນັກເຕະທັງສອງໄດ້ຮ່ວມມືກັນ.
outcome.round_both_defect: ນັກເຕະທັງສອງໄດ້ຫຼົບຫນີ.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: ຜູ້ນ 0 ຮ່ວມມື, ຜູ້ນ 1 ໄດ້ຫຼົບຫນີ.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: ຜູ້ນ 0 ໄດ້ຫຼົບຫນີ, ຜູ້ນ 1 ໄດ້ຮ່ວມມືກັນ.
